# Graph Simulator

> A free, browser-based graph theory simulator for creating, visualizing, and studying graphs.

Graph Simulator lets learners create directed or undirected, weighted or unweighted graphs. Add named vertices and edges, including directed self-loops; inspect connected components and simple cycles; compare neighbor lists, adjacency matrices, and edge lists; and follow representation-building algorithms step by step. Graphs and imported JSON files stay in the browser.

The site is available in English and French. Each language has a stable URL. The interactive simulator and its documentation are public pages; legal information is available separately.

## Pages

- English home: https://graph.fleothing.com/en-us/
- English interactive simulator: https://graph.fleothing.com/en-us/simulator
- English documentation: https://graph.fleothing.com/en-us/docs
- French home: https://graph.fleothing.com/fr-fr/
- French interactive simulator: https://graph.fleothing.com/fr-fr/simulator
- French documentation: https://graph.fleothing.com/fr-fr/docs
- English legal information: https://graph.fleothing.com/en-us/legal
- French legal information: https://graph.fleothing.com/fr-fr/legal
